profile.headline: Software Engineer at Omnissa(C#)
profile.summary:
I am an IT professional with knowledge of web/mobile automation and enterprise mobile device management.As a quality assurance engineer, I see a great joy in finding solution for real world mobility problems with the knowledge and expertise I have.My hardworking and problem solving attitude with high quality standards help me to achieve doing things in better and efficient ways for the company.I always look for expanding my boundaries in education, skillsets and experience to excell my career at every level. 

At Airwatch, I am gaining a valuable experience in testing and automating  of various console module(SDK,Third party certificate authority integration with Airwatch, Syslog, SMS, Smart groups, user management) and Airwatch services(Airwatch cloud connector, Airwatch cloud messaging system, Enterprise Integration service). I am leading an effort to transform existing manual testing into automation scripts using Ruby, Cucumber and Watir framework with Appium and SeeTest tools. I am currently driving a new automation project SITH(Software Integrated Test Harness) using Java, Selenuim, test NG, appium and SeeTest for SDK on both ios and Android platforms. As a team member, I offer wide range of experience in mobile device management and automation with great efficiency, speed and management skills.

positions.title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
positions.description:
-	Automated mobile apps using java, testNG, appium, seetest tools on both platforms (iOS, Android). 
-	Configured continuous integration pipeline for executing smoke and regression automated tests.
-	Developed and maintained an automation framework using ruby, cucumber and watir Framework. 
-	Automated test cases for web application using ruby, cucumber and water.
-	Participated in automation scripts code reviews and provided feedback for code quality.
-	Analyzed test results of continuous integration execution for the script issues, product defects, environment configuration issues.
-	Provided the detailed report to the management on product quality for every release.
-	Trained different scrum teams on automation framework and tools, continuous integration. 
-	Analyzed product feature requirements and created detailed functional/Integration test plans.
-	Performed functional acceptance, regression, smoke, end-to-end testing for web and mobile applications.
-	Wrote and Automated complex SQL queries and stored procedures against the database for various testing needs.
-	Analyzed various product issues, identified and logged product defects during testing.
-	Coordinated with developers to resolve and close the defects, verified fixes prior to the release. 
-	Worked closely with remote teams in Bangalore, California to achieve the project milestones and release timelines. 
-	Created and Maintained various product/scrum team documents on confluence.
-	Participated in various team meetings like release kick off, sprint planning/demo/retrospective, standups.
-	Engaged in troubleshooting post production issues and customer escalations after release.
-	Experienced in Configuring virtual machine and deploying web application using installers.

Languages:  Java,Ruby
Automation Tools: TestNG, Selenuim, Appium, SeeTest, Cucumber, Watir
Skills: HPQC, JIRA, Stash, Git, bamboo, Jenkins, SQL
Github:  https://github.com/hpatelaw    Bitbucket: https://bitbucket.org/hepatel/

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
-	Assisted professor in laboratory.
-	Helped students in troubleshooting errors of in lab experiments.
-	Managed day to day laboratory activities (grading lab reports, assisting students in lab experiments).

Technical strengths:

Microsoft Excel, Matlab, Control System, Digital Signal Processing, Lab Reports, Grading.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-	Conducted tutorial lectures, laboratories and examinations.
-	Prepared questions for tutorials, semester tests 
-	Graded lab reports and tutorials.

Technical strengths:

Embedded System, Digital circuits, Analog Electronics, Electronics circuits-2, Mechatronics, Matlab
